navigation.notes: Five tabs, labels always visible, order mirrors in RTL and never changes (ADR 0007 D1). No tab for Compare or the human planner: Compare is a tray plus a pushed table (CL-SAVD-02, CL-SAVD-04) and the planner is a module in My Wedding and Services. The launch tab is Discover, except My Wedding when any request is approved and waiting for the 24 hour confirmation, a voucher is ready with no request yet, or a booking is confirmed; My Wedding shows a dot only when a confirmation is due within 24 hours or a voucher is about to expire. Bookings are canonical in My Wedding > Bookings (CL-BKNG-01); the Home status card, the Profile row and every booking notification are shortcuts to the same screens. Tab bar is hidden in onboarding, the booking flow, the gallery viewer, the chat composer, the Compare table, the full-screen map and the payment web view (the KD 2 voucher payment); it stays visible on other pushed screens. Sheets: Brief, filters, sort, calendar, package, cancel, proposed-date response, add expense, schedule meeting. Pushes: venue detail, booking detail, Compare, chat thread, checklist, budget. Per-tab stacks persist; re-tapping the active tab pops to root then scrolls to top. Three-tap rule: every requirement group is at most three taps from a tab root (free on my date 0 to 1, compare two venues 3, booking status 1 to 2, message a venue 2, change language 3 (Profile tab, Language row, choose), delete account 3). Prototype P0 spine (full fidelity, wired): CL-ONBD-04, CL-ONBD-05, CL-DISC-01..04, CL-VENU-01..03, CL-SAVD-01, CL-SAVD-02, CL-SAVD-04, CL-VCHR-01..03, CL-PAYM-01..05 (the KD 2 voucher payment), CL-BOOK-01..10, CL-BKNG-01, CL-BKNG-02 (variants: Pending, Approved, Confirmed, Not accepted), CL-BKNG-04 (the counter-offer that CL-BKNG-02 links to, the client side of HL-DCSN-03), CL-VIST-01..03, CL-WEDD-01, CL-MSGS-01, CL-MSGS-02, CL-AUTH-01, CL-AUTH-02; everything else is built to design-system standard. The prototype is seeded with one shared request (Reem Al-Dosari to Aurelia Gulf Hotel, Thu 14 Jan 2027, 350 guests, standard KD 18,200.000, voucher price KD 15,400.000 as an illustrative seed value, voucher GV-2611-K7QM, reference GZ-2611-0147 owned by the fixtures author) that must read identically in the hotel app. Dev-server URLs are never typed by hand: use the identity-checked command from ADR 0021 (tools/ports.mjs) so a screenshot is never taken of another project's server.
navigation.voucherModel: ADR 0033 (2026-10-14): Ghazal sells a KD 2 voucher; venues and providers sell and collect everything else. Tabs and tab order are unchanged. New entry points: My vouchers and Visits in Profile (CL-VCHR-02, CL-VIST-04), Get voucher and Book a visit on the venue detail, the Additional services hub in Discover (Venues | Additional services). Loyalty and Rewards are superseded (CL-RVRW-03, CL-RVRW-04 deprecated).

parkedRequirements.reason: Deferred (360-degree virtual tour). designScope is false; keep a content-model field only and no UI, as the PRD and ADRs state.
Deferred (installment payments). No UI, no placeholder row ('Installments (soon)' is explicitly not designed).

Un-deferred by ADR 0033: decoration, catering, buffet, florals and planning are now the five primary Additional services categories (CA-SVC-13); the hub renders categories from data. Retired from the parked list; kept here as the record.
Phase 3 (AI-recommended venues). The MVP ships the rules-based 'Recommended for you' shelf (CA-HOME-15) with no AI label.
Phase 3 (AI budget optimisation). The MVP budget shows rule-based alerts only (CA-TOOL-09).

Superseded by ADR 0033 (CA-LOY-01..07): loyalty points, the coupons wallet and referral rewards are replaced by the KD 2 voucher. CL-RVRW-03 and CL-RVRW-04 are deprecated. Referral rewards are an open question (OQ-V-16).
Superseded by ADR 0033: instant booking no longer exists (no deposit to hold the date). The Instant filter, the Instant badge and the Book action are removed.
MVP-P2: visit reminders (24 h and 2 h) are designed in the chat and notification screens; build order may slip.

globalRules: No guest mode (ADR 0038, CA-AUTH-13): a signed-out person sees only the first-run screens, language, introduction and sign-in (phone first with a WhatsApp code; the password is the tertiary path), then About you for a new account (name and sex required, Terms and Privacy accepted) and the optional onboarding steps. Nothing else is shown before the account exists: there is no guest-gate sheet, no 'sign in to see' state and no sample state, and every Client screen assumes a signed-in client. Hearts and the Compare set live on the account. Account deletion is always initiated in-app. The Partner app keeps its signed-out screens (HL-ACCS-*).

One identity entry (CL-AUTH-01) is the only sign-in surface: a full screen that follows the introduction (ADR 0038). A verified phone (WhatsApp code) is required to send a request and is verified inline in booking step 4 if missing.

Booking model (ADR 0033, replacing ADR 0001 D1 to D4): request-then-confirm with a KD 2 voucher. Ghazal sells only the voucher, paid online (KNET, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay); the client then requests a hall or service at the voucher price, the venue approves or declines within its reply time, the client confirms within 24 hours of approval, pays the venue directly off-app and shows the voucher code or QR to be redeemed. A client may skip the voucher and pay the venue the standard price. The CTA is "Get voucher" (and "Send request" once a voucher is ready), never "Book now"; there is no instant booking. Requests do not claim the calendar and move no money; approval creates a 24 hour hold; competing requests show a calm "Date held by another couple" chip with no counts. Client times are absolute ("Expected reply by Fri 13 Nov, 12:40 PM", "Confirm by Fri 13 Nov, 4:00 PM"); a live countdown appears only in the final 60 minutes of the confirm window. The saving and the KD 2 fee are shown before the voucher is bought.

One canonical Booking detail with status variants (never one screen per status), plus the shared Booking Thread (Request, Approval, Confirmation, Redemption, Day). Status chips are always icon plus label: Pending, Approved (confirm within 24 h), Confirmed, Voucher redeemed, Not accepted, Expired, Cancelled, Completed. A declined, lapsed or withdrawn request returns the voucher (reusable at the same venue for 60 days, refundable in venue-fault cases); there is no refund of event money because none moves through Ghazal.

Booking granularity (ADR 0002): hall x date x session with up to two sections (ladies and men). Hall switcher, session chips and audience chips appear only when there is a real choice; 'Mixed' is last and never the default. Government halls are listing-only with an official-channel hand-off: no Ghazal checkout, deposit, instant tag, availability claim or reviews.

Money and numbers (ADR 0010, 0004, 0016): Western digits 0-9 in both languages, comma thousands, dot decimals; Arabic 'د.ك' after an LTR-isolated number, English 'KD'; 'KWD' only on invoices, receipts, bank settings and the gateway. Browse surfaces show whole dinars when fils are zero, otherwise exactly three decimals; booking, deposit, balance, payment, refund and invoice surfaces always show three decimals. A price always states its unit and guest basis; a bare 'From KD X' never appears. Strings come from the shared formatter, never hand-typed. Western digits convert only via the Arabic-only Settings row. Voucher model: every package shows two prices on the same basis, the voucher price as the headline and the standard price beneath; the fee is "KD 2" in English and «2 د.ك» in Arabic (three decimals on receipts only).

Dates and time (ADR 0011): Gregorian primary, Sunday-first weeks, Thu-Sat peak band at the inline-end edge, 12-hour Asia/Kuwait time. Hijri appears only as a muted line in Arabic on date confirmations and booking summaries, and as approximate occasion markers on calendars. Never numeric-only dates, never 'ليلة' plus a weekday. Fixed NOW is Thu 12 Nov 2026, 4:00 PM; relative words only for Today and Tomorrow. Custom calendars only (no native pickers).

Arabic and English voice (ADR 0013): written natively, not translated; honorific plural possessive 'كم', CTAs as verbal nouns, light Gulf warmth only in welcomes, success, push and empty states, guests are 'ضيف / ضيوف' everywhere. English is British, warm, precise and calm. No exclamation marks, no emoji, no urgency or scarcity words, no 'Welcome back'. One celebratory line per flow, at confirmation. Dialect belongs only in typed chat. Banned phrases and terms are listed in `docs/design/content-guidelines.md` (glossary section 9) and are enforced by the i18n lint.

Imagery and avatars (ADR 0015): empty rooms and details only, no identifiable faces, no alcohol, no royal or state emblems, no real brands or landmarks. Avatars are one-letter monograms in their own script; no avatar upload anywhere. Section badges are text chips, never pictograms.

RTL (ADR 0014): logical properties only, every icon has a mirror flag, no swipe-to-reveal actions (every action has a visible control or a long-press menu), carousels start with the first item at the right, time axes run in reading direction, LTR isolates for phones, codes, money and references, and every screen is verified at 360, 390 and 430 in both languages. Prototypes are drawn through the real components, not by flipping an English frame.

Compare (ADR 0009): maximum three, tray appears only after the first add and only on Home, Results and Saved, collapses to a pill, is replaced by a header badge on Venue detail, never appears in booking, My Wedding, Messages or Profile and never triggers a push. The fourth add always opens 'Replace which one?'. The table is full-bleed fluid thirds with label above value, differences-only by default, with a 14-character English and 12-character Arabic cell budget.

Offline and errors: browse screens show cached content with an 'Updated {time}' stamp; anything that moves money or commits a decision (send request, pay, cancel, accept a proposed date) is never queued and is disabled in place with a plain reason; chat messages may queue. Every key surface has loading (static skeleton, no shimmer), empty, error and offline states with calm, blameless copy.

Notifications (ADR 0007 D10 and D11): the OS permission is requested after the first save or first booking request, never at launch. Transactional notifications always deliver and land on the exact object with the stack rebuilt (tab root, parent, target). Marketing is opt-in, quiet hours apply, at most two a week and none in the final seven days before the wedding.

Motion (ADR 0017): four durations, two curves, one thread motif; one success moment per flow (640 ms, check plus thread completion, success haptic, no confetti); money and counts never roll; reduced motion cross-fades. Planner tiers use one, two or three thread marks, never metal colours.

Priorities: 'core' marks the prototype spine and screens that carry a novel pattern; 'supporting' screens are built to design-system standard by recombining shared sheets, lists and forms. Screen IDs are permanent. MVP-P2 areas (planner, services, chat, reviews, rewards, planning tools) are designed now but may slip in build order; loyalty is the first candidate to slip (CF-30).

Open owner decisions that stay placeholders in this inventory and must be flagged in the design (docs/product/open-questions.md section 2b, OQ-V-01 to OQ-V-16): voucher binding, validity and reuse window, refund and reuse table, listing plan rates (never shown as numbers), whether ordinary hotels and halls also pay a listing plan, governmental facilities browse-only, guest visibility of the voucher price, visits for providers, referral rewards; plus the older OQ-B-15 ("No booking fee" wording), OQ-B-10 (government-hall eligibility), OQ-B-11 (occasion chip), OQ-B-12 (share links), OQ-B-13 (notify me if this date opens), planner consultation pricing (OQ-P-19). Cancellation tiers, deposit and balance (ADR 0005, 0006) no longer exist.

Voucher states and rules (ADR 0033): unpaid, active (ready), bound (in a request), used, expired, refunded. One voucher per request, one code and QR, bound to one venue or provider and quote at purchase, offered only when the saving beats the KD 2 fee; Governmental Facilities are browse-only with no voucher. Clients with a verified phone buy vouchers (there is no guest mode, ADR 0038).

Visits and the group chat (ADR 0033 D9): Book a visit is free and independent of the voucher, offered for hotels and halls only; each visit opens a dedicated chat of exactly three roles (client, hotel representative, Ghazal support) with visible role chips, member-only visibility and read-only closing 24 hours after the slot.

Additional services (ADR 0033 D8): five primary categories (Hospitality and catering, Buffet services, Floral arrangements, Event styling and decor, Event planning and coordination) then secondary ones; only approved, active listings appear; paid placement is labelled.
notes: Business model: the voucher marketplace (ADR 0033, docs/product/voucher-model.md). Screens changed by the pivot are listed in docs/product/voucher-model-changes.json (new, changed, deprecated per flow).
Deprecated screens stay in their flow files with "deprecated": true and a reason; they are never renumbered or deleted. Builders skip them.

Repurposed screens keep their ids and slugs: CL-PAYM-01..05 are now the KD 2 voucher payment and outcome; CL-BKNG-03 is Cancel request (voucher outcome); CL-BKNG-05 is Receipts; CL-VENU-05 is Terms; CL-SERV-01 is the Additional services hub.
Prices are illustrative seed values until the fixtures owner sets them (voucher prices per package); advertising plan rates are not decided and no screen shows a number for them.
